evidence: Kew/POWO accepts Ulmus alata and lists Texas in its native range.
Texas A&M Rangelands explicitly treats winged elm as native and maps it to several Texas ecoregions including the Blackland Prairies, Cross Timbers, and Edwards Plateau.
Texas Forest Service describes its Texas range from eastern Texas south to the Guadalupe River valley.
The project source pool contains one research-grade wild user observation, but its county is not being inferred from the source-pool row.
target_zone_range.blocking_issue: B012 did not recover three exact project target counties with sufficiently explicit native/wild documentation. Regional/eccoregional evidence shows that the species reaches the broader project region, so FAIL would overstate the evidence.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Do not convert ecoregion presence, a broad Guadalupe-valley statement, or an unlocated iNaturalist observation into three county records.

morphology.look_here_first: Look at young and older branches first: regular corky wings are the signature. Then check that the wings usually stop abruptly at the leaf node, the leaves are pointed, and reproduction is in spring.
diagnostic_traits: prominent regular corky wings commonly present on young and older branches
wings generally terminate abruptly at leaf nodes
leaves generally small, lanceolate to oblanceolate/elliptic, pointed, double-serrate
flowers before or around leaf-out in spring
spring samara oblong with white cilia/hairs
wings may be weak or absent on rapidly growing trees, so fruit and season remain useful

confusers.separator: Cedar elm may also be winged, but its wings can continue around nodes, its leaves tend to be blunter/rougher, and it flowers/fruits in fall.
American elm has much larger asymmetric leaves and normally smooth unwinged branches.
Sweetgum can have corky twig growth, but the leaves are palmately lobed rather than simple pinnately veined elm leaves.

installation_guardrail: Do not install as a project-native until three target-zone counties are documented or Calvin explicitly approves a range-evidence exception.
